_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Disbelief with coil base rate dominant; no named breaker has fired, so HOLD is the graded call until fear_greed or flows force a ±1 rung.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicit HOLD in Disbelief; narrative neutral-constructive on inflows only—no opposing phase call, split is pattern blowoff label vs live sideways regime
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear_greed ~50-65, funding near flat, inflows remain contained
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear_greed breaks mid-40s with VIX spike and persistent exchange inflows, or ETF flows/momentum re-accelerate enough to push score into Hope
